raw_record.standard_answer: By taking the slope of a line tangent to the $NO_2$ curve at t = 30 s

method.method_draft: From the reaction setup, infer that NO2 is the initially present reactant, so on the graph it is the decreasing curve. At t = 30 s, draw a tangent line to that NO2 curve and determine its slope from two points on the tangent. The instantaneous rate of disappearance of NO2 is the magnitude of that slope, i.e. -d[NO2]/dt at 30 s.
